violations.title: Food Contact Surface, 4 Hour Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed pizza cutters located at the oven that are not being cleaned at least every 4 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils must be cleaned and sanitized at least every 4 hours to prevent contamination by bacterial growth. CDI washed sanitized

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: artichokes 2 weeks old
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. CDI discarded

violations.title: RTE TCS Commercially Processed Food, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is commercially processed is not used or discarded within 24 hours of when the original container was opened and is not observed to be date marked: meatballs and artichokes
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety commercially processed foods when opened and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of the original container was opened. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. This date cannot exceed any manufacturer determined 'use-by' date based on food safety. CDI marked

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. Spray bottle without label
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CDI labeled degreaser

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: oil squirt bottle
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a QUATERNARY AMMONIA, test kit. CDI EHS provided strip
